subtopic: 05 · Trigonometric Identities and Compound Angle Formulas
title: One master key, and the tree that grows from it

board_content.text: The forest is really one seed
Sum, difference, double, half, triple, product-to-sum, sum-to-product — they all descend from a single identity.

board_content.caption: Every compound-angle formula descends from cos(A − B)

board_content.text: Replace $B$ with $-B$ to get $\cos(A+B)$. Use $\sin\theta=\cos(\tfrac{\pi}{2}-\theta)$ to get $\sin(A\pm B)$.
Set $B=A$ for the double-angle formulas; halve for half-angle; add and subtract pairs for product-to-sum.
Learn the derivation, not the list. Under pressure you reconstruct in twenty seconds.

segments_english.text: This subtopic looks like a forest of formulas, so let me hand you the one seed they all grow from.
Sum, difference, double, half, triple, product-to-sum, sum-to-product, every one of them is the same idea in a different costume.
The master key is the cosine difference formula: cosine of A minus B equals cosine A cosine B plus sine A sine B. Burn this one in.
Here's the family tree. Everything you'll ever need in this subtopic hangs off that single root at the top.
Watch how they grow. Replace B with minus B and you get cosine of A plus B. Use the cofunction shift, sine equals cosine of ninety minus the angle, and out fall sine of A plus or minus B.
Set B equal to A and you get the double-angle formulas. Halve the angle for half-angle. Add and subtract pairs and you get product-to-sum. One idea, eight costumes.
So the instruction is: don't memorise the list, learn the derivation. Under exam pressure you can rebuild any of them from cosine of A minus B in about twenty seconds, and it never fails you.

segments_hinglish.text: ये subtopic formulas का जंगल लगता है, so मैं आपको वो एक बीज देता हूँ जिससे सब उगते हैं.
Sum, difference, double, half, triple, product-to-sum, sum-to-product, हर एक वही idea है अलग costume में.
Master key है cosine difference formula: cosine of A minus B equals cosine A cosine B plus sine A sine B. इसे पक्का कर लीजिए.
ये रहा family tree. इस subtopic में जो कुछ चाहिए वो सब ऊपर के उस एक root से लटकता है.
देखिए कैसे उगते हैं. B को minus B से replace कीजिए और मिलता है cosine of A plus B. Cofunction shift use कीजिए, sine equals cosine of ninety minus angle, और निकल आते हैं sine of A plus or minus B.
B को A के बराबर कीजिए और मिलते हैं double-angle formulas. Angle आधा कीजिए half-angle के लिए. Pairs add और subtract कीजिए product-to-sum के लिए. एक idea, आठ costumes.
So instruction ये है: list रटिए मत, derivation सीखिए. Exam pressure में आप किसी को भी cosine of A minus B से करीब बीस seconds में rebuild कर सकते हैं, और ये कभी fail नहीं करता.
